summary: preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes a large obfuscated payload
details: The package's `preinstall` hook runs `node setup.mjs`, which downloads the Bun standalone runtime (v1.3.13) from GitHub and uses it to execute a sibling file `math_init.js`. `math_init.js` is a 727 KB heavily obfuscated JavaScript file using rotated string-array obfuscation (obfuscator.io shape: array-rotation function, hex-encoded constant table, custom character-decoder), and its name and content bear no relation to the package's advertised purpose as a small SDK client. `setup.mjs` itself is obfuscated in the same style, using hex-named identifiers and wrapper-object indirection (e.g., `_0x19328d.YCZJE(execFileSync, "ldd",...)`) to hide the download-unzip-chmod-execute flow. Node can already execute JavaScript natively, so routing execution through a downloaded Bun binary serves only to bypass Node-oriented tooling and inspection. Installing this package causes an obfuscated bundle to execute on the installer's machine at install time under an out-of-band runtime.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
